heading: Halloween in the Okanagan 2026
title: Halloween in the Okanagan 2026 | Okanagan Roam
description: Haunted corn mazes, ghost tours, family Halloween events and costume nights out across the Okanagan for October 2026, with dates and towns.
intro: This guide covers Halloween season in fall 2026, from a haunted corn maze north of Vernon to costume dances in Osoyoos. Times, prices and dates can change, so open each event page for current details before you head out.
We've grouped things by the kind of Halloween you're after. Each item shows its town and date.

items.name: Field of Screams XIII: The Unlucky
items.text: four separate walk-through mazes at Historic O'Keefe Ranch north of Vernon, each with its own set and its own live scare actors waiting in the corn. The mazes start taking people at 6:30, so the whole thing happens in the dark, and Wednesdays are discounted all season. Organizers don't recommend it for children under 12.

items.name: Ghost Tours of Vernon
items.text: costumed hosts lead lantern-lit walking tours through downtown Vernon's Lower East Hill, mixing local history with ghost stories, a tradition now in its 23rd year. The flagship tour runs about 1 hour 45 minutes, and the season is July–August and October.

items.name: Caetani Cultural Centre
items.text: the historic heritage home of artist Sveva Caetani, which hosts art workshops, markets and seasonal ghost tours.

items.name: Exit Kelowna Escape Games
items.text: five themed escape rooms, including one called Haunted. A solid pick for groups and families.

items.name: Xperience Games Kelowna
items.text: tech-based escape rooms with no locks or keys, such as Haunted Apartment. Most games run 60 minutes for 2 to 6 players, ages 7 and up.
